profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Brex

positions.title: Team Member - Data Mining Project
positions.description:
•Worked in a team of 4 and used machine learning algorithms, the Natural Language Processing Toolkit (NLTK) and an open-source Java data mining tool to tag emotions in sentences.
•Created a web application to receive input and collaboration from internet users to help classify data manually for the training set, and collect it to enhance previously collected data.
•Developed and implemented feature extraction and processing algorithms in Python.
•Used tools to tag Barrack Obama's State of the Union speech and analyzed fluctuation of emotions.

positions.title: Grades Open Source Project - Software Engineering
positions.description: •Contributed to an open-source project by redesigning and implementing a new user interface, refactoring code, fixing bugs and designing and implementing a new feature.
